senses.gloss: लुट् general name for affixes of the first future which are added to roots when the future time is not the present day, but the next and the succeeding ones; cf. अनद्यतने लुट् P. III. 3.15. The affixes ति, त: etc. replace the affix लुट् in acco- rdance with the number and person in view; cf. तिप्तस्झिसिप् .... P. III. 4 78.
